purpose: Ensure closure, dismissal, termination, completion, or retraction events do not erase earlier public-record carriers.
rules: Lifecycle updates append to history; they do not delete history.
Retraction of findings is a dated source event, not a database-wide deletion command.
If source material is withdrawn, mark carrier state and rollback dependent claims; do not silently remove the carrier.
Public copy must distinguish historical source existence from current legal force.
